smart_lists.name: 🔥 HOT LEADS (Score ≥ 15)
smart_lists.description: High-intent sellers who replied, completed intake, or received an offer.
smart_lists.action_playbook: Immediate dial within 5 minutes. Offer presentation or closing call.

smart_lists.name: ⚡ Uncontacted Leads (SLA < 24h)
smart_lists.description: Fresh inbound leads awaiting first outbound telephone contact.
smart_lists.action_playbook: Rep must place 3 call attempts + SMS within first 4 hours.

smart_lists.name: ⚠️ SLA At Risk (24h - 48h Warning)
smart_lists.description: Leads uncontacted between 24 and 48 hours. Subject to automated revocation.
smart_lists.action_playbook: Manager alerts assigned rep. Call before 48h automated reassignment.

smart_lists.name: 🚨 SLA Breached / Reassigned (48h+)
smart_lists.description: Leads stripped from inactive reps and re-routed to top performers.
smart_lists.action_playbook: New assignee executes rapid apology + VIP triage script.

smart_lists.name: 📞 Scheduled Calls & Appointments Today
smart_lists.description: All seller discovery and offer presentations booked for today.
smart_lists.action_playbook: Review property comp packet 15 min prior. Execute structured script.

smart_lists.name: 📝 Intake Completed — Needs Offer Calculation
smart_lists.description: Sellers who finished online intake form; awaiting underwriting.
smart_lists.action_playbook: Run MAO formula (ARV * 0.70 - Repairs - Spread). Extend offer within 4h.

smart_lists.name: 📨 Offers Sent — Awaiting Signature
smart_lists.description: Active contracts extended to sellers pending electronic signature.
smart_lists.action_playbook: Daily 10:00 AM check-in. Overcome closing cost and timeline objections.

smart_lists.name: 👻 Ghosted Post-Offer (72h Recovery)
smart_lists.description: Sellers who went silent 72 hours after receiving purchase offer.
smart_lists.action_playbook: Deploy psychological takeaway SMS: 'Should I release our cash hold on [Address]?'

smart_lists.name: 🔄 Active 0–7 Day High Frequency Drip
smart_lists.description: Sellers receiving automated multi-channel Day 0–7 rapid touch sequence.
smart_lists.action_playbook: Monitor for inbound replies. Immediately engage upon inbound SMS.

smart_lists.name: 🌱 Active 30-Day Nurture Pipeline
smart_lists.description: Medium-motivation sellers receiving educational and market update drips.
smart_lists.action_playbook: Bi-weekly personal check-in call to test for life milestone updates.

smart_lists.name: 💣 120+ Day Reactivation Blitz Target
smart_lists.description: Historical cold leads queued for quarterly wake-up blitz.
smart_lists.action_playbook: Deploy 9-word text: 'Are you still open to a clean cash offer on [Address]?'

smart_lists.name: 📧 Email-Only Leads (No Phone Available)
smart_lists.description: Web intake submissions without phone numbers.
smart_lists.action_playbook: Automated email sequence driving to instant valuation booking page.
